name: Booxboo.de Publishing Distribution
author: Chris Ribal

sections.description:
Production-, distribution- and inventory management for publishers and self-publishing all in one – Booxboo.de is a cloud-based software for professional publishing organizations that supports you in the distribution of your books: From book planning to marketing, from order processing to inventory management and fulfillment with real-time data analysis. Including the physical infrastructure warehouse and distribution.

More information about Booxboo.de can be found at https://www.booxboo.de.

This plugin synchronizes WooCommerce orders with your Booxboo.de account. It transfers orders from WooCommerce to Booxboo.de and updates the order status in WooCommerce as soon as the order has been processed and shipped in fulfillment.

Note: After successful setup, this plugin automatically transfers your orders to our interface (api.booxboo.de). Personal data of your customers is also transmitted in the process.

Do you have further questions or need help? Contact us at technik@booxboo.de.

External Services

To automatically transfer orders from WooCommerce to your account at Booxboo.de, a connection to the REST API is established. This is located in sandbox mode at “https://westarp-api.ribal-webentwicklung.de”, in live mode at “https://api.booxboo.de”. The connection is encrypted in both modes and, after successful orders, transmits all order data as well as the customer’s shipping and billing address to our software.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin via the WordPress Plugin Manager or download the plugin and extract it to the wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin in the WordPress Plugin Manager.
  3. Create your personal API token your Booxboo.de Account under Settings > API.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Booxboo.de and enter your previously created API token. Select “Production” as environment.
  5. Click “Save”.
  6. Verify that all your products have a valid ISBN entered.
